d: HD-DA4-4KZ-E 1:4 HDMI® Distribution Amplifier w/4K60 4:4:4 & HDR Support

specs.label: Input Signal Type
specs.value: HDMI w/HDR10, Deep Color, 3D, & 4K60 4:4:4 support (DVI & Dual-Mode DisplayPort compatible)

specs.label: Output Signal Type
specs.value: HDMI w/HDR10, Deep Color, 3D, & 4K60 4:4:4 support (DVI compatible)

specs.label: Copy Protection
specs.value: Selectable for HDCP 2.2, HDCP 1.4, or HDCP disabled

specs.label: Audio formats
specs.value: Dolby Digital®, Dolby Digital EX, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby TrueHD, Dolby Atmos, DTS®, DTS-ES, DTS 96/24, DTS HD High Res, DTS HD Master Audio, DTS:X, LPCM up to 8 channels

specs.label: USB
specs.value: USB 2.0 host; supports firmware update and custom EDID upload via a USB flash drive

specs.label: HDCP Version
specs.value: Selectable for HDCP 2.2, 1.4, or OFF; HDCP encrypted content is blanked in OFF mode

specs.label: EDID Mode
specs.value: Selectable for DEFAULT or COPY 1ST; • The factory default EDID is 4K60 4:4:4 non-HDR video with 2-channel LPCM audio; • The factory default EDID can be replaced with a custom EDID via USB; • Sliding the switch from DEFAU

specs.label: Power Pack (included)
specs.value: Input: 100-240 Volts AC, 50/60 Hz; Output: 0.75 Amps @ 24 Volts DC; Model: PW-2407WU

specs.label: Chassis
specs.value: Metal, black finish, with (2) integral mounting flanges
